app.name: Medienpass

assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.subject: Subject
assessment.empty: You have not created any assessment yet
assessment.emptyHint: Create the first one to start assessing digital competencies.

assessment.versionImmutableHint: This version is published and cannot be modified. Create a new version to edit it.
assessment.name: Version name

assessment.deleteAttempts: {count} attempts and their grades, from {students} students
assessment.certificateEnable: Issue a certificate to those who pass
assessment.certificateHint: Anyone who passes can download a PDF certifying the KMK competences they demonstrated. You can switch this on even after publishing.

question.competencyRequired: Every question must measure a KMK competency
question.empty: This assessment has no questions yet

media.guidanceHint: Appears next to the record button. For example: "Explain your reasoning, do not read the text out."
media.guidanceSelfieHint: Appears next to the camera. For example: "The finished build should be visible behind you."
media.maxSecondsHint: You can ask for less, never more than {seconds} s. The limit protects storage and the time of whoever marks it.
media.secureContextNote: Camera and microphone only work over HTTPS or on this computer. Over a network address without a certificate the browser blocks them.

smart.examplePlaceholder: Raise my maths score from 70 to 85 by studying 30 minutes a day for 6 weeks
smart.minCharsHint: Only a prompt for the writer; it does not block submitting.
smart.rubricFixed: The rubric is fixed and worth {max} points. It is not configured per question: if every teacher redefined it, the per-dimension statistics could no longer be added up across classes.
smart.showRubricHint: Recommended. The rubric is what is being taught; hiding it turns the task into guessing.

editor.hotspotHint: Click on the image to add an area.
editor.orderingHint: Write the items in their correct order.
editor.blankHint: Each blank is written as a placeholder in double curly braces.

attempt.finishWarning: Once finished you will not be able to change your answers.
attempt.dragToOrder: Drag to reorder, or use the arrows
attempt.expiredHint: Your answers have been saved and submitted automatically.
attempt.savedForLater: Saved. You can pick it up whenever you want.
attempt.resumableHint: This assessment has no time limit: you can save it and continue later.
attempt.oneSittingHint: This assessment is timed: the clock runs even if you close the page, so it is best finished in one sitting.

result.title: Result
result.pendingReviewHint: Your teacher still has to mark the open answers. The grade is provisional.
result.certificateHint: Certifies the KMK competences you demonstrated in this assessment.

grade.accessibleDescription: Grade {value} on a scale where {worst} is the worst result. Rating: {label}.
grade.scaleLegend: On this scale 1.0 is the best result and 6.0 the worst. More stars mean a better grade.

kmk.title: KMK digital competencies
kmk.breakdownHint: The same competence seen by subject, by class or student by student. A class average hides both the student far behind and the one far ahead.
kmk.notMeasuredHint: This competence has not been assessed here yet.
kmk.truncated: Showing the {shown} rows with the most answers, out of {total}. Filter by class or subject to see the rest.
kmk.noBreakdown: No answers to break down with these filters yet.
kmk.levelScale: Starting below 50%, developing up to 70%, established up to 90%, advanced above that.

group.title: Groups
group.noStudents: This group has no students yet.
group.withoutEmail: {count} students without an institutional email. They cannot sign in until one is assigned.

student.title: Students
student.issueForPending: Only for those who cannot sign in yet
student.sharedPasswordHint: Leave empty to generate a different one for each student
student.forceChange: Force a change on first sign-in
student.issuedWarning: These passwords are shown only once. Save or hand them out now: they cannot be looked up again.
student.name: Name

training.title: KMK training
training.intro: Six modules, one per KMK digital competency. Each has material and an assessment that uses the same engine as the students’ one.
training.empty: There are no training modules yet.
training.noAssessment: This module has no published assessment yet.
training.passingHint: The passing threshold for teachers is 80%, stricter than for students.

admin.title: Training content
admin.intro: Write the material teachers will see: formatted text, images, videos, links and attachments. Nothing is visible until you publish it.
admin.codeHint: Short and stable. It identifies the module and should not change.
admin.moduleDescriptionHint: What is read in the listing, before opening it. One or two sentences.
admin.noBlocks: The module has no material yet. Add the first block.
admin.blockBodyHint: Formatted text. Images are inserted from the toolbar.
admin.urlHint: Required for video and link. Optional in other blocks.
admin.draftNotice: It is a draft: teachers cannot see it. Publish it when it is ready.
admin.needsContent: Add at least one material block before publishing.
admin.needsOneLanguage: Write it in at least one language.
admin.noAssessment: This module has no linked assessment, so it cannot be certified.

ai.title: Generate assessment with AI
ai.draftNotice: The result is always a draft. Nothing reaches a student until you review and publish it.
ai.notConfigured: The AI provider is not configured. The API key is missing.
ai.contextHint: What was covered in class, which tools they use, what vocabulary to use and what to avoid.
ai.contextPlaceholder: E.g.: we use Google Docs and Wikipedia. We covered citing sources but not search operators. Avoid social-media examples.
ai.competenciesHint: At least one. Questions will be spread across those chosen.
ai.questionTypesHint: Only the types the model can reliably generate are offered.
ai.generatingHint: Writing thirty good questions takes a while: up to a couple of minutes. Do not close this page.
ai.rejected: The response failed validation and was discarded
ai.simulatedTitle: The AI is in simulation mode
ai.simulatedHint: Without an API key the generator returns placeholder questions with the right shape but no relation to the topic. Useful to test the flow, not to prepare a class.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Role permissions, platform settings, academic year and data maintenance.

roles.adminLocked: The administrator role always keeps every permission. Being able to remove them would leave nobody able to grant them back.

settings.aiEnabledHint: When off, users with the permission still see the option but the server rejects it.
settings.studentEmailDomainHint: Each student email is their code followed by this domain.

year.title: Start academic year
year.intro: Creates the new year and replicates last year groups, empty of students. The previous year stays intact with all its grades.
year.noSource: There is no current academic year to copy from.
year.name: Name
year.copyTeachersHint: Without a homeroom teacher, a teacher cannot assign assessments to that group.
year.confirmHint: Type "{code}" to confirm. This changes the year the whole school works in.
year.nextStep: Next step: sync with Phidias to bring in enrolment.
year.purgeEvidence: Also delete the {count} evidence files from the closing year
year.purgeEvidenceHint: The previous year keeps its grades. A grade given on evidence that no longer exists is a grade nobody can justify later.
year.evidenceDeleted: {count} evidence files from the previous year were deleted.

data.backfillIntro: Aligns each student email and username with their code. It changes how they sign in, so simulate first.
data.withoutCode: {count} without a code: no basis to derive the email.
data.conflicts: {count} conflicts: the derived email already belongs to another account. Usually duplicate codes in enrolment.

storage.title: Stored files
storage.intro: Student evidence and question images. They live outside the database and are always served through temporary links.
storage.purgeIntro: Choose the scope, simulate and review before deleting. There is no copy: what is deleted cannot be recovered.
storage.irreversible: The storage has no versioning: deletion is permanent.
storage.reasonPlaceholder: Recorded in the audit log. E.g.: data retention for 2025-2026.
storage.countChanged: The file count changed while you were reviewing ({count} now). Nothing was deleted; simulate again.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.allowHint: Students can upload photos, documents or audio with their answer.
evidence.hint: Images, PDF, audio, video or Office documents. Up to 25 MB per file.
evidence.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Please try again.
evidence.limitReached: You have reached the maximum of {count} files.

preview.title: Preview
preview.notice: This is how a student sees the assessment. You can answer to try it out: nothing you write here is saved.
preview.noSolution: This question has no correct answer marked and cannot be graded.
preview.manualGrading: Graded by the teacher: there is no answer key to show.
preview.evidenceHint: The student can attach up to {count} files.

report.title: Results by group
report.intro: How this assessment went in each class, and which questions were hardest.
report.noResults: There are no submissions for this assessment yet.
report.hardestHint: Sorted by observed difficulty, not the declared one. When they disagree, the problem is usually the wording.

public.footer: The school platform for academic assessment and digital competence.
public.privacyNote: Student work and grades are visible only to those with a reason to see them.
public.screenNote: A sketch of the screen regions, not a screenshot.

media.answerSaved: Your answer is saved. You can record it again if you want.
media.insecureContext: The browser will not allow camera or microphone at this address. The platform has to be opened over HTTPS or on this computer; tell whoever is serving it.
media.permissionDenied: You did not allow the camera or microphone. You can grant it again from the icon in the browser address bar.
media.previewOnly: This only shows how your class will see it. Recording works when actually answering.

review.emptyHint: Open answers and recordings appear here as soon as someone submits them.
review.feedbackHint: What they did well and what to look at next time
review.intro: {count} answers waiting for a mark, oldest first.
review.title: Marking queue
review.aiSuggestion: The mark and feedback were suggested by AI. Check them: once you save, the mark is yours.

smart.charsRemaining: {count} characters short of the minimum length.
smart.longEnough: Long enough. Check that all five dimensions are there.
smart.noData: No SMART goals have been marked with the rubric yet.
smart.notAGoalHint: SMART does not assess whether the goal was met, but how it is written. A goal can be impeccable and still not be reached.
smart.placeholder: Write your goal here. For example: "Raise my maths score from 70 to 85 by studying 30 minutes a day for the next 6 weeks."
smart.rubricHint: The marks are a writing aid, not your grade: whoever marks it scores each dimension from 0 to 4.
smart.statsHint: The average of each dimension out of 4. It says what needs teaching again: usually the deadline and the measurable indicator.
smart.title: SMART goals

SPECIFIC.name: Specific
SPECIFIC.indicator: States clearly what will be done, what for and, where relevant, how

MEASURABLE.name: Measurable
MEASURABLE.indicator: Includes a quantity, percentage, frequency or something that lets the result be checked

ACHIEVABLE.name: Achievable
ACHIEVABLE.indicator: Is possible with the time, resources and knowledge available

RELEVANT.name: Relevant
RELEVANT.indicator: Has a clear purpose and answers a need or a goal

TIME_BOUND.name: Time-bound
TIME_BOUND.indicator: Sets a deadline or a specific period

users.emptyHint: Try another profile or change the search.
users.grantAdminWarning: Administration can do everything: create and delete accounts, see any student’s data, change passwords and delete assessments along with their grades.
users.name: Name
users.needsRole: An account with no role gets into the platform and can do nothing.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username or email
users.summary: {total} accounts, of which {admins} can administer everything.
users.temporaryHint: Shown only once. It must be changed on sign-in, and open sessions have been closed.
users.title: Staff and accounts

roleMeaning.ADMIN: Can do everything: accounts, roles, passwords, deletions and anyone’s data.
roleMeaning.STUDENT: Answers the assessments assigned to them and sees their own results.
roleMeaning.TEACHER: Creates and assigns assessments, marks them and sees their classes’ results.

users.deleteSubtitle: You are removing access for {name}. This cannot be undone from here.
users.deleteKeeps: Their history is kept: assessments they graded and attempts they made stay in place, with their authorship.
users.deleteFrees: Their username and email are released in case they need reassigning, and every open session is closed.
users.createSubtitle: Teacher, administration or student. Roles can be changed later.
users.createdOnce: Temporary password for {name}. It is shown once and must be changed on first sign-in.
users.signInWithSsoHint: No password is stored. The account activates the first time they sign in with Microsoft.
users.signInWithPasswordHint: For people without an institutional account.

groupPasswords.confirmHint: This will change the password of {count} students.
groupPasswords.individualHint: Recommended. A readable password is generated for each and handed over as a list.
groupPasswords.intro: Reset the password of every student in the class at once. Each has to change it on sign-in, and open sessions are closed.
groupPasswords.onceOnly: These passwords are shown only once and are not stored anywhere. Copy or download them before closing.
groupPasswords.shared: The same one for the whole class
groupPasswords.sharedHint: Convenient for dictating in class on the first day.
groupPasswords.sharedPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. It only serves for the first sign-in.
groupPasswords.sharedWarning: With a shared password, until each student changes it, anyone in the class can sign in as anyone else and see their grades and their work.
groupPasswords.title: Class passwords
